node.title: KoalaBear degree-60 decomposition divisor adapter
node.closure: exact zero and pole divisor pullback
node.statement: For every residual geometric decomposition f=F composed h of the KoalaBear degree-60 endpoint f=V_act/A^5, the reduced 60-point active divisor is exactly a union of complete unramified h-fibers and the reduced 12-point source divisor has the exact fiber and ramification profile prescribed by the eight-row pole ladder. This proves local active/source set preservation only; it supplies no coefficient-field descent, full evaluation-domain quotient, witness-data descent, owner, charge, cap 68, u2 close, or row close.
